forum.title: Regression on a trust zone disabled STM32H563 in closed state and DA_cofig.obk not programmed
forum.best_answer_content:
Dear @NithinKurian

Unfortunately, in this situation the MCU is **effectively lost** (no way to regress or reopen it) because debug authentication was not provisioned before moving to the CLOSED lifecycle.

Best regards

Lobna
forum.content_text:
Hi

I have STM32H563 Nucleo board which is in closed state with DA\_Config.obk not programmed, And the trust zone disabled.

This was done by mistake, Is there a way to do regression on it.

Operations Done on the device.

1.Done the regression

2.Set the product state to provisioning

3.Programmed OEMiRoT\_Config.obk

4.Set the device to closed state.
